task: redteam S4 paired test + S3 scaling control (step13, real computation)

spec.metric: risk = 1 - precision in top-coverage flagged band (step6b caliber); diff = risk_gate - risk_random
spec.excluded: scf_k562 (in-situ arm only, no sibling product) and scf_rpe1 (product missing) per R2 amendment A2
spec.pairing: both arms recomputed on the same bootstrap resample; random arm = 3 fixed seeds x 1 draw per coverage per resample (primary, mc3), or the resample base rate = expected precision of random rejection (robustness, expected)
spec.random_baseline_point_curve: on the full data, 3 seeds x 1000 draws per coverage, averaged over seeds

spec.primary_control: probe input features StandardScaler (fit once on full data) -> retrain -> re-evaluate AUROC, vs step6 original in-fold-scaler pipeline (same folds)
spec.supplementary: predicted delta scaled by constant factor [0.5, 2.0], features recomputed, labels unchanged (pearson invariant), original protocol re-eval
spec.caveat: 全数据 fit 的 scaler 在口径上微跨测试折；该对照的目的正是把缩放射到 CV 口径外观察 AUROC 是否移动

original_protocol.desc: step6 run_probe: fold 内 StandardScaler + L2 logistic (C=1.0), stratified 5-fold CV shuffle seed=0; headline = CV AUROC mean

unified_scaler_control.desc: StandardScaler 全数据一次 fit（统一缩放）后纯 LR 重训，同一 CV 划分重评

no_scaling_diagnostic.desc: 诊断（非主对照）：原始量纲特征直接进 LR，无任何缩放

delta_x0.5.label: y unchanged (pearson_delta invariant to positive rescaling of predicted delta)

delta_x2.0.label: y unchanged (pearson_delta invariant to positive rescaling of predicted delta)
